scope: Visual review of all seven actually opened DEV public-journey captures. This review does not relabel the preserved raw collector report.

captures.method: tools.view_image; full public 1280 x 800 capture inspected without editing
captures.observation: Davin is present in the world and as a complete portrait. The assignment text and both choices are readable; no neighbouring atlas frame is visible.

captures.method: tools.view_image; full public 1280 x 800 capture inspected without editing
captures.observation: The optional encounter shows two small varrens and a larger alpha as three distinct bodies. Native feet and isolated frame crops are readable; all three matching target controls are visible.

captures.method: tools.view_image; full public 1280 x 800 capture inspected without editing
captures.observation: The public combat log records Kaidan’s burst and damage to the alpha. The alpha is targeted; the three bodies remain isolated and grounded. The image does not establish biting or locomotion.

captures.method: tools.view_image; full public 1280 x 800 capture inspected without editing
captures.observation: The public victory screen states three defeated opponents and fourteen total actions. Its copy correctly delays assignment rewards until the report. The raw run records nine player orders, with enemy actions included in the total.

captures.method: tools.view_image; full public 1280 x 800 capture inspected without editing
captures.observation: The report dialogue and confirmation choice are readable with Davin’s complete portrait. The screenshot still shows a save-import toast, consistent with the explicitly declared position-only return fixture.

captures.method: tools.view_image; full public 1280 x 800 capture inspected without editing
captures.observation: The reloaded public world is visible at Davin. The active objective has returned to the main Feros mission; exported completion state is checked by the separate qualification.

captures.method: tools.view_image; full public 1280 x 800 capture inspected without editing
captures.observation: This final screenshot shows the same valid completed world. It was taken after the collector assertion rejected three favicon-only console messages; it does not depict a failed battle or failed reward.

findings: No fauna atlas neighbour or clipped animal body was observed in the two combat captures.
Three varrens are visually distinct, with a larger alpha, and match the three public target IDs.
The assignment briefing, report and victory text fit their panels at the inspected desktop viewport.
The exported state, rewards, imports and source hashes are verified by the separate qualification, not inferred solely from screenshots.
limitations: Earlier Eden/Citadel progression and the first Feros encounter are prepared in Node through native callbacks, not played in this browser.
The walks from Davin to the pack and back are not played: position-only fixtures are derived from actual public exports. Native A* geometry coverage is separate.
Three opponents condense the source-described pack; no exact original enemy count, attack damage or reward is certified.
Creature body poses are static prototypes. This does not certify original locomotion, anatomy, biting animations or physical-device performance.
Visual inspection covers one desktop Chromium/SwiftShader viewport. Static creature drawings remain prototypes; original anatomy and a faithful original animation set are not certified.
